title: feat(slider): allow setting which Pits to show
body:
A prop `valuesToShow={[0, 50, 100]}` allows you to specify which percentages to show. The annoying part is that not for every % a Pit is rendered. The values are:

```js
const pitValues = [0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 26, 29, 32, 35, 38, 41, 44, 47, 50, 53, 56, 59, 62, 65, 68, 71, 74, 76, 79, 82, 85, 88, 91, 94, 97, 100];
```

I'm not sure what to make of it.

related to #2276

Only for review since I continued on #2276
